manual.reason: The 304 branch is the shared HttpCache conditional-request discipline, already covered by its own route families; here only the `?since=` reply is pinned mechanically.
manual.steps: GET /api/chain-digests, take `fingerprint`, then GET /api/chain-digests?since=<fingerprint> and GET /api/chain-digests with If-None-Match set to the first response's ETag on an isolated instance.
manual.expected: The first reply carries the digest map; the since-call answers {v,fingerprint,unchanged:true} in 57 bytes; the conditional call answers 304 with no body.

manual.reason: The regression that motivated this change is a request-count shape across a whole console session; a deterministic replay counter reproduces the old and the new provider on the production row/key counts.
manual.steps: Run evidence/replay-count.mjs against the main provider and against the branch provider (fixture: 1108 delegate rows, 2328 chain keys) and compare the boot and reconnect totals.
manual.expected: Before: 2217 requests per round (1108 detail + 1108 children). After: 42 per round (1 row + 1 digest + 24 details + 16 child legs), and zero detail requests once the mirror is warm and the digest is unchanged.
